notes:
Account snapshot: Nimbus Recall Ops is a global FS data platform focused on regulatory search and eDiscovery for enterprise clients. They plan to unify event logs, filings, and annotated transcripts into a single semantic index. Primary ask: a production-ready RAG search stack that handles massive-scale embeddings (hundreds of millions to ~1B vectors) with deterministic p95 latency and sub-cent query unit economics.

AE notes (Maya): initial discovery 2024-07 — strong technical interest; legal/security heavy. They said: "we cannot accept unknown egress costs, and we need audit trails and KMS control". Priorities: 1) index density and cost per query 2) predictable tail latency 3) secure multi-region deployment.

SE feedback (Jonah): recommend Dedicated for initial POC due to predictable throughput and ability to tune batching/eviction policies. Discussed caching: prefix + KV cache for hot documents, and tiered storage for older vectors. Reranking pipeline: embed -> dense retrieval -> light re-ranker (cross-encoder) for top-N (N=20) to reduce compute.

Commercial: procurement timeline around Q1 2025 if POC meets latency + cost targets.
